'''P'laang Ri's hangar''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]], owned by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[P'laang Ri]]. When the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] came to collect favors owed by Ri, he borrowed Ri's [[Zeta-class long-range shuttle|''Zeta''-class shuttle]] ''[[Arkanoid]]'' for a mission and left his own [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in Ri's hangar for safekeeping.<ref name="renegade">''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]''</ref>
